expected_metrics.meaning: Finalized net account credits, not necessarily current-month production earnings
Actually deposited YouTube payments plus disjoint outside-platform cash receipts
Cleared cash inflows minus recorded paid refunds and expenses
Months with no observed bank payment, not months of zero creator earnings
Months with finalized posting but no cleared YouTube bank payment, not necessarily an account hold
Run length without cleared platform receipts; may reflect thresholds, transit, pauses or holds
Descriptive standard deviation divided by positive average cash inflow, not an industry risk forecast
Negative recorded monthly liquidity change, not necessarily negative accrued accounting profit

analysis_rules: Only an already reconciled result from the verified monthly ledger is accepted; summary row consistency is independently rechecked.
A finalized amount posted to AdSense is distinct from a cleared YouTube bank receipt. No bank payment can be inferred from an eligible payout threshold.
Bank transfer date and upload month differ. A zero-payment calendar month does not establish zero revenue or a failed channel.
A large deposit can be delayed accumulated balances, not a spike of current-month video earnings.
CV is descriptive and computed only for nonnegative cash inflows with a strictly positive mean; it is null if the mean is zero.
The rolling window must be at least three consecutive complete months; smaller, missing or nonconsecutive observations are rejected.
Monthly cash movement is not net income, wage, taxable profit or expected future creator earnings.
No cross-creator volatility distribution can be produced from one account; representative cohorts require consent, matching currency and period, and explicit no-earnings inclusion.
Static repository fixtures contain no real bank accounts, individual receipts, private credentials or creator-income forecasts.
